caveat: The walk-outcome population is untruncated but off-distribution: walk outcomes are uniform-random gate survivors per rung, not frontier candidates ordered by priority. The harvest logs are the on-distribution arm but are LEFT-TRUNCATED at the v7-era tau_h, so a rate conditioned inside them understates waste under v10's looser cuts. Neither arm is unbiased for the live rate; this one errs in the known direction.
